title: Philippine Senate Blue Ribbon Commission and 176 Yamashita treasure troves

tellings.quote: the Blue Ribbon Commission is charged with finding these 176 troves of treasure that have been buried in the Philippines by General Yakushima at the end of World War II.

plain: At the end of World War II, the story goes, the Japanese general Yamashita buried 176 troves of treasure in the Philippines, and a Philippine Senate body called the Blue Ribbon Commission was later given the job of finding them. The lawyer Dan Sheehan tells Michels this as something people told him, naming a Senator Pimentel and a Mr. Ayala (on the show he calls the general 'Yakushima'). If true, it would mean that a huge hidden fortune from the war is real and has been officially searched for.
